instruction: Cinematic film still, full shot. Inside a martial arts gym with a white training mat, pull-up racks, and a red wall mural, two men are sparring. On the left, the barefoot man in the black t-shirt and black leggings (R1) stands in a defensive boxing stance with his hands raised. On the right, the man in the black t-shirt, black shorts, and dark athletic shoes (R2) lunges forward in an active stance, closing the distance. In the background, a blurred bystander in a patterned shirt stands near a mirror. Moody gym lighting casts soft shadows on the mat, highlighting the dynamic action against the warm red background.
elements: R2 lunges forward and closes distance while R1 remains defensive
R1 keeps a defensive boxing stance with hands raised while R2 attacks forward
R1 and R2 are sparring as opponents with distinct defensive versus advancing roles
white training mat beneath the sparring action
pull-up racks in the martial arts gym
red wall mural in the gym background
